verifiers.name: Outcome Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks whether the declared mission result matches the environment truth and acceptance rule.

verifiers.name: Constitutional Constraint Verifier
verifiers.description: Fails closed on critical misses, unauthorized actions, safety, rights, privacy, budget or governance violations.

verifiers.name: Evidence Coverage Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks that material conclusions carry sufficient attributable evidence for the mission stage.

verifiers.name: Process Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks required intermediate controls, declared tool use, bounded steps and escalation behaviour.

verifiers.name: Complete-Denominator Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks compute, external services, human burden, evidence, requalification and unwind costs.

verifiers.name: Transfer Verifier
verifiers.description: Checks whether capability persists across the preregistered mission family rather than one memorized distribution.

verifiers.name: Verifier Red-Team
verifiers.description: Attacks the verifier bundle for false acceptance, reward hacking, leakage and scorer exploitation.

governing_doctrine: The Foundry remains sovereign over every algorithm. Training proposes capability; fresh proof and accountable admission govern status and authority.
